question: Who truly qualifies as accomplished beyond the Vedas?
premises: One delights in the knowledge of brahman.
Such a person is called a brahmin.
Such a person has gone beyond the Vedas.
inference: True Vedic accomplishment lies in delight in brahman-knowledge.
plain_english: Whoever delights in the knowledge of Brahman, he is the brahmin who has gone beyond the Vedas.
